svg.text: Showcase ground extent — 420 m to 8000 m
2026-09-22 · L_GuangzhouLandmarkShowcase · the ring no longer sits on a floating slab, and an eye-level camera no longer looks past the ground into the sky atmosphere below the horizon
WHAT THE EYE-LEVEL FRAME CONTAINS
BEFORE — 420 m plane, half extent 210 m
building
sky
ground
no geometry — 27 px of the frame
is sky atmosphere below the horizon
AFTER — 8000 m plane, half extent 4000 m
building
sky
ground — reaches the horizon
band is 1 px — the plane edge
is 0.06 deg below the horizon
Both strips are the same camera: the Guidemen eye-level view, 400 cm high, 50 m from the plaza centre.
The band height is atan(camera height / half extent), and at 900 px over a 36 deg vertical FOV that is 25 px per degree.
HOW IT WAS FOUND, AND HOW IT IS CHECKED
Found by ray trace, not by eye: row 510 of that frame hits no geometry at all, while rows 560 / 700 / 860 hit Showcase_Ground at 90 / 28 / 15 m.
(Scripts/ProbeShowcaseFrameGeometry.py) The ground and the atmosphere band are both blue, so the plane's edge was invisible and the blue merely read as continuous.
The hero view was the visible symptom — the ring sat on a slab with black void beyond it. Now the plane fills the hero frame and its edge falls outside it.
Rebuilt and re-validated: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 34 actors, 9 landmark lights, isolation unchanged, ground bounds ±400000 cm. One quad, so the size costs nothing.
